title: Word order and clause boundaries
subtitle: Do not mistake a moved word for a new sentence.
overview: In connected Greek, a fronted object, prepositional phrase, or participle may interrupt the English-like order you expect.
Use agreement, articles, and finite verbs to mark boundaries; only after that notice prominence created by placement.

sections.title: Boundary anchors
rows: attaches to its noun despite distance

items.grc: ταῦτα ἐν ἀρχῇ ἐποίησεν ὁ θεός.
items.en: God did these things in the beginning.
